title: Heading and lemma of the homily
english: Of the same, from a homily delivered in the church of Cyrinus on the thirteenth of the month Phamenoth according to the Egyptians, in which he interprets the saying of Isaiah which says: "Death swallowed, having prevailed, and again" (Isaiah 25:8).
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 77; Homilia in ecclesia Cyrini via Khazarzar (Homilia habita in ecclesia Cyrini.pdf).
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No copyrighted English base. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.
baehrens: PG 77; Homilia in ecclesia Cyrini hom rem early
orientation: This is the title and opening lemma of Cyril's homily, introducing the Isaiah text he will interpret.

title: God's will for an incorruptible humanity
english: God removed every tear from every face (Isaiah 25:8). For the God of all things, inasmuch as he is life and life-giving, willed that the human being should be an incorruptible living creature on earth, even if he is of a corruptible nature.

orientation: Cyril has just quoted Isaiah 25:8 and now begins to explain it by describing God's original intention for the human race.

title: The adversary's plot against humanity
english: But he, since he was wicked and envious, plotted against the race, was opposing the will of the Creator, and cunningly brought it down into disobedience, knowing that through it it would fall into death.

orientation: The homilist has just stated God's will that humanity be incorruptible, and now turns to the unnamed adversary who opposed that will.
